title: labels top aligned by default
name: Labels top aligned by default
rule: Labels top-aligned by default; left-align only if space is tight and fields are consistent type/width.
pass_when: Labels sit above fields; left-aligned labels only when space is tight and fields share type/width.
fail_when: Left-aligned labels on mixed-type/width fields, or as the default when space is not tight.
overview: Fluent labels sit above fields; left-align only when space and widths allow.
apply_when: Aligning Fluent field labels in forms with mixed or tight layouts.
not_when: Ant left-default label placement — dual-cite, do not force one winner.
agent_hint: Default labels above fields; left-align only if space is tight and widths match.
description: Fluent labels are top-aligned by default so each field keeps a lasting name above the control. Left-align labels only if space is tight and fields share consistent type and width. Dual-cite Ant’s left-default without forcing a house winner. Apply when aligning Fluent field labels in forms. Fail left-aligned labels on mixed-type or mixed-width fields, or left as the default when space is not tight.
do_not_claim: GOV.UK above-the-control as a merge of sentence-case/colons. Overlap with Forms 54: beyond LIVE `visible_label` / `label_stays_visible`.
